name: South Lane Mental Health- 5th St

nadir.desc: The property consists of multiple single-story commercial buildings with light-colored roofs arranged around a large paved parking lot|The parking lot contains marked spaces, accessible stalls, and numerous vehicles|Street frontage runs along S 5th St with additional curb parking|Landscaping and trees line portions of the building edges|Adjacent commercial buildings share the same block.

alpha.desc: The front of the site shows a large paved parking lot with multiple vehicles and marked spaces|Two primary commercial buildings face the lot, including one with visible “Cascade Rentals” signage|Street frontage and sidewalks run along the edge of the property|Landscaping is present near the buildings|Circulation lanes connect the lot to the street.

bravo.desc: The left side of the site shows the commercial buildings along the street, a smaller parking area near one building, and the larger paved lot beyond|Multiple vehicles are parked along the curb and in the lot|Trees and landscaping screen portions of the building street frontage|Adjacent streets and neighboring buildings border the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the site shows the back of the commercial buildings facing S 5th St|Trees and landscaping run along the street-facing side|Multiple vehicles are parked along the curb|The large paved parking lot is visible behind the buildings|Neighboring commercial structures enclose the block.

delta.desc: The right side of the site shows the large paved parking lot, one of the commercial buildings, and adjacent structures|Multiple vehicles occupy the lot|Equipment or stored items are visible near one building|Street access and circulation lanes connect the lot to the surrounding streets.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from S 5th St into a large paved parking lot that provides clear circulation and staging space. Multiple single-story commercial buildings occupy the site. Curb parking is present along the street. The property is in a downtown commercial area. Neighboring buildings share the block and may affect approach routes.
clarifications: Which building on the lot is the South Lane Mental Health entrance? Are the parking lot and adjacent buildings under the same control, or are they separately operated? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle route through the lot? Do any gates or barriers control access between the street and the rear parking area? Is there a rear or side staff entrance separate from the public entry?
